༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi gsal byed gnam lcags rdo rje'i dpal gyi rnam par bshad pa bdud sde 'joms pa

tei:bibl.tei:idno: GuruLamaWorks/Precious-and-Rare-Disk-01-20130424/rtfs/4_AMAI/AMAI062_dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi rnam bshad/.rtf

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi gsal byed gnam lcags rdo rje'i dpal gyi rnam par bshad pa bdud sde 'joms pa'i ye shes kyi me chen phrin las kyi 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /dge legs 'phel// rgya gar skad du/ sarba bud+dha s+ya ru pa badz+ra dha ra sh+tsa dwe ya shrī dharma swā mi gu ru trī ṇi sh+tsa bha ga wan badz+ra ku mā ra ye na ma/ bod skad du/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo rdo rje 'chang dang gnyis su med pa'i dpal chos kyi rje bla ma gsum dang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /srid zhi kun khyab bde ba'i rang bzhin rnam thar gsum dngos kun tu bzang / /de nyid gdul bya dag pa'i 'gro la mkha' sbyor skur bstan rdo rje sems/ /mchog dman skye bo kun gyi snang ngor mtshan brgyad ldan pa'i pad 'byung ste/ /chos sku longs sku sprul sku zhes grags brgyud pa'i rtsa ba rnam gsum rgyal/ /snang ba ma lus lha yi 'khor lo lham me ba/ /grag stong sgra kun gsang sngags rang sgrar lhang nge ba/ /chos kun bde stong zung 'jug ngang du lhan ne ba/ /grub mchog ded dpon 'khon ston rim par byon la 'dud/ /zab yangs rgyud sde bye ba'i gsang mdzod can/ /sa skya'i bla chen kun dga' snying po dang / /zur phud lnga pa dge bsnyen mchog gi zol/ /rje btsun sku mched zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod/ /rdo rje phur pa'i rtsa dum rgyud rgyal gyi/ /bsgyur byed thub dbang gnyis pa sa paṇa dang / /gangs khrod bstan 'dzin kun gyi rgyan gcig pu/ /dpal ldan 'phags pa'i yon tan bsam bzhin dang / /de lta'i 'gran bral rje btsun mchog rnams dang / /rnam thar du ma'i sgo nas tshul mtshungs shing / /khyad par snga 'gyur bstan pa'i rtsa lag mchog /'gro mgon bsod nams rgyal mtshan bsngags par 'os/ /gzhan yang sku tshe mdzad pa 'phrin las kun/

/mthar phyin theg chen chos kyi rgyal po dang / /nus mthu'i mnga' bdag rgya gar sher bzang mtshan/ /sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje phyag gi gnas/ /gangs ri'i ljongs 'dir zas gtsang sras kyi bstan pa'i rgyun/ /'dzin skyong spel mdzad dam pa'i skyes bu mang byon yang / /kun gyis 'gran bral ngo mtshar rnam thar bye ba'i gter/ /sprul pa'i skyes chen sngags 'chang kun dga' rin chen rgyal/ /lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu nyid/ /gzhan ngor ngur smrig gos dang gos dkar gyis/ /mdzes pa'i bstan 'dzin mchog gi skur bstan pa'i/ /bka' drin mnyam med 'jam dbyangs sku mched dang / /dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs mus pa rje/ /rje btsun 'grel tshad don ldan yongs 'dzin mchog /mchog gsum ngo bo dngos grub ma lus kun/ /kun tu rtsol der rtag par phyag bgyi 'o/ /sku gsum zhal ldan phyin drug phyag gi yal gas mdzes/ /bsdu dngos zhabs kyis dbang phyug pho mo'i steng na brjid/ /gar dgu'i nyams ldan dpal chen he ru ka dpal dang / /'phrin las phur bu'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'dud/ /dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i gtor bzlog gi /tshig don rnam bshad bdud sde kun 'joms pa'i/ /ye shes me chen 'phrin las 'od zer tshogs/ /kun tu 'phro ba'i bstan bcos 'chad la spro/ /'di la dpal ldan dkar mo lcam dral dang / /dam can ma mo sde gsum mched bcu gnyis/ /bstan ma la sogs bka' srung khyed rnams kyis/ /zab don byed la gnang ba'i skabs stsol cig /ces mchod par brjod cing rtsom par dam bcas te bka' srung rnams la gnang ba'i skabs gsol nas/ sngar rang nyid kyis brtsams pa'i bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i gdams pa nyams len gyi chu bo chen po sgrub pa'i thabs kyi rnam par bshad pa phrin las kyi pad+mo rab tu rgyas pa'i nyin byed ces bya ba'i gsum pa tshogs tha ma bsgral ba'i mchod pa'i skabs su de nyid kyi rgyas bshad logs su 'chad par khas blangs pa de nyid don dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/

'dir dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi gsal byed gnam lcags rdo rje'i dpal gyi rnam par bshad pa bdud sde 'joms pa'i ye shes kyi me chen 'phrin las kyi 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba zhes bya ba 'di 'chad pa la don gnyis te/ gang bshad par bya ba'i gzhi ngos bzung ba dang / de nyid gtan la dbab pa'o/ /dang po ni/ 'o skol gyi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po de nyid kyis theg pa'i dbye ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig gsungs pa rnams kyi nang nas ches zab cing mchog tu gyur pa ni gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa yin la/ de la yang gsang sngags rnying ma dang gsar ma gnyis sam/ snga 'gyur dang phyi 'gyur gnyis su yod pa las 'dir gsang sngags rnying ma snga 'gyur gyi lugs yin zhing / de la'ang phyi'i theg pa dang nang gi theg pa gnyis su yod pa'i/ phyi'i theg pa la nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' ste pha rol tu phyin pa'i theg pa gsum dang / nang gi theg pa la yang phyi nang gnyis las/ kri ya ste bya ba/ u pa ste spyod pa/ yo ga ste rnal 'byor gyi rgyud gsum la phyi'i rgyud sde'am theg pa gsum dang / mahā yo ga ste rnal 'byor chen po dang / a nu yo ga ste rjes su rnal 'byor dang / a ti yo ga ste shin tu rnal 'byor gsum la thabs dang / shes rab dang / thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i rgyud de nang gi theg pa gsum mam rgyud sde gsum zhes bya ba'i rnam gzhag mdzad cing / yang pha rgyud do ha'i skor dang / ma rgyud la sgyu 'phrul gyi skor dang / gnyis med la sems phyogs zhes kyang grags la/ lung a nu yo ga shes rab kyi rgyud la tan+t+ra chen po sde bco brgyad la sogs pa'i rgyud sde bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig yod pa'i nang nas/ mchog tu gyur pa rdo rje phur pa 'di'i skor la rdo rje khros pa bi to ta ma la 'bum sde'i rgyud/

de'i le lag zur du phyung ba phur pa rtsa dum gyi rgyud/ gzhan yang myang 'das/ gsar rnying kī la ya yig 'bru bcu gnyis pa karma ma la 'phrin las kyi rgyud la sogs pa rtsa ba dang bshad pa'i rgyud de dag nas bstan pa'i lam gyi rnam par gzhag pa du ma zhig gsungs pa de thams cad bsdu na/ stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i lam gyi rim pa dang / smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i lam gyi rim pa gnyis su 'dus pa las/ 'dir lam rim gnyis pa smad las dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i rnam gzhag 'chad pa la/ khog don drug gi sgo nas bshad pa'i skabs su gab pa'i sngags drug dang tshe lung khrus lung gis kha bskang ste gdab pa'i las bya zhes gdab las bya ba la tshe lung khrus lung gnyis shes dgos par gsungs shing / de gnyis shes pa'ang gnang tho bcu gnyis shes pa la rag las pas/ de bas na rgyud kyi gnang tho bcu gnyis khog don phyi ma gnyis dang bcas pa nyams su len pa'i rim par sbyar ba bcom ldan 'das rdo rje phur pa'i gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi lhan thabs gsal byed gnam lcags rdo rje'i dpal zhes bya ba 'di gang bshad par bya ba'i gzhi yin no/ /gnyis pa de nyid gtan la dbab pa la de lta bu'i rdo rje phur pa'i gtor bzlog gi gzhung 'di la bla ma gong ma rnams kyis mdzad pa'i rnam bshad kyi rim pa ji ltar yod ce na/ bla ma sa skya pa sgrub thabs las byang chen po/ rje btsun tho yig rin po che/ chos rje sa rtsa dum gyi 'gyur paṇa/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa slob tshogs dang bcas pa/ bdag chen rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ snyigs dus kyi bstan pa'i nyi ma sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras sogs 'khrul zad gong ma de dag gis mdzad pa'i rdo rje phur pa'i chos skor gyi smad las kyi phyogs bstan pa rnams la/ gsung rab kyi don la dpyod nus pa'i blo gros kyi mig dang ldan pa rnams kyis lta shes na don gyis rdo rje phur pa'i gtor bzlog gi gzhung gi 'grel par snang mod/

'on kyang bzlog gzhung gi dbu zhabs yongs su rdzogs pa'i rnam bshad phyogs gcig tu mdzad pa ni med la/ 'o na deng sang sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can gyis mdzad do zer ba'i rnam bshad zhig 'dug pa ji ltar yin snyam na/ 'di ni sngags 'chang bla ma de nyid kyis mdzad pa ma yin te yab rje chos kyi rgyal po de nyid kyi dngos kyi gsung las/ phur bzlog gi rnam bshad 'di ni nged dang nyer gnas rab 'byams kun rin zhig gis gsar bu'i blo can 'ga' zhig gi don du gsung rab la rtog dpyod zhib tu ma byas par hol spyod kyis bsgrigs nas dngos cag gis byas so zhes kha 'phangs pa yin gyi/ kho bos de 'dra'i rnam bshad nam yang byas pa med do zhes yang yang du gsung ba thos pas na/ dus phyis bdag gis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i rje btsun sbas pa'i sangs rgyas bka' drin mtshungs pa ma mchis pa de nyid kyi gsung 'bum gyi khrod du yang rnam bshad de nyid bzhugs su gsol bar ma nus pa yin pas/ rjes 'jug rnam dpyod dang ldan pa rnams kyis blun po ri bong cal rgyug can rnams kyi rjes su mi 'brang ba gal che ba lags/ mdzad do zer ba'i rnam bshad de la ni mchod brjod sbyar byang sogs gtan nas med pa dang / yang rang rang gi bsam tshod dang bstun pa'i 'dra min sna tshogs bris pa dang / bshad pa rang gi skabs rnams la'ang dpyad par bya ba'i gzhi du ma dang / tshig sbyor yang mi legs pa mang du snang bas mang thos bshes gnyen rnams kyis gzigs pa na rnam bshad rang gi rang tshad gsal por ston pa zhig 'dug go /da ni gzhung don gtan la dbab pa la gsum ste/ sngon 'gro mchod brjod dam bcar bcas te bstan/ /dngos gzhi sbyor dngos rjes gsum cho ga bshad/ /rjes bya bsngo ba mdzad byang smos pa 'o/ /dang po la/ 'phags yul legs sbyar skad kyis gus phyag 'tshal/ /bod skad tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas bstud/

/bstan bcos rtsom pa'i dam bca' bstan pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzhung las/ na maḥshrī badz+ra ku mā ra ya zhes pa ste/ de yang na maḥphyag 'tshal lo/ /gang la 'tshal na shrī ste dpal/ badz+ra ste rdo rje/ ku ma ra ya ste gzhon nu la zhes par 'gyur bas na/ dpal rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i don no/ /gnyis pa bod skad tshigs su bcad pa'i sgo nas bstud pa ni/ gzhung las/ 'od gsal dbyings las khro bo'i sku/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste de yang rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba chos kyi dbyings kyi ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du gdul bya gdug pa can 'dul ba'i phyir khro bo'i rnam par bzhengs pa sku rdo rje/ kun tu brjod pa'i cho 'phrul gyis rnam par 'phrul pa mtha' yas pa'i bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes bskyed pa'i phyir don dam 'gyur med stong pa nyid kyi chos ston pa gsung rdo rje/ bde stong zung 'jug smra bsam brjod pa'i mtha' thams cad bral ba stong nyid rdo rje'i rang bzhin can gyi thugs rdo rje ste/ de ltar rdo rje gsum gyi go 'phang brnyes pa'i lhag pa'i lha mchog rdo rje gzhon nu dang rtsom pa po sa skya lo tsā ba nyid kyis rtsa ba'i bla ma dbyer mi phyed pa gang de'i zhabs la gus pas rab tu bstud nas zhes pa'i don no/ /gsum pa bstan bcos rtsom pa'i dam bca' bstan pa ni/ gzhung las/ de yi 'phrin las mngon spyod kyi/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig ste/ de ltar mchod par brjod nas/ lhag pa'i lha mchog de yi mdzad pa 'phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i nang tshan drag po mngon spyod kyi sgo nas las kyi mtha' mar bya ba lha tshogs drag po'i las la bskul ba'i cho ga slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i las bzhi mchongs brgyad kyi bye brag nag po sngags lung dang / gzhan rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bla ma dam pa/

sngags 'chang shes rab snang ba sogs kyi gsung rab kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ nus mthu'i mnga' bdag rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos mdzad pa'i gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms la brten nas gzugs can gyi dgra dang / gzugs med kyi bgegs kun gyi lus ngag thal ba'i rdul ltar 'joms shing rnam shes dag pa'i zhing du skyel ba'i rnam gzhag gsal bar byed pa'i legs bshad rin po che'i 'phreng ba ltar tshig don spel legs mtshar du dngar ba bsgrigs pa'i brda rnying 'di nyid/ snod ldan gzhan la spel zhing 'phel ba'i phyir bshad par bya zhes pa'i don no/ /'dir smras pa/ phar phyin lugs la rnam gzhag gzhan gsungs kyang / /rdo rje theg pa'i skabs 'dir bla ma dang / /dbyer med lhag pa'i lha la mchod brjod nas/ /dam par gtogs phyir rtsom par dam bca'i tshul/ /'di ni mkhas pas sbyar ba'i bstan bcos kyi/ /klad don sngon du 'gro ba'i chos yin te/ /de ltar bgyis la 'thad pa mang mchis pa/ /shes par 'dod na gong ma'i gsung rab ltos/ /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gnyis pa dngos gzhi sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyi cho ga bshad pa la/ sbyor ba rten dang mchod gtor sogs gshom tshul bshad pa/ dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa sogs la 'jug tshul bshad pa/ rjes drag po'i las dngos kyi cho ga bshad pa dang gsum las/ dang po ni/ gzhung las/ 'dir bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje gzhon nu'i gtor ma'i cho gas pha rol gnod pa bzlog tshul cung zad brjod na zhes pa nas/ gu gul la sogs pa bshams la zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan te/ de dag gi don yang skabs 'dir bdud bzhi bcom pa dang / dbang phyug gi yon tan drug dang ldan pa'i bcom ldan 'das gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi dpal dang ldan zhing / stong nyid rtogs pa'i shes rab kyi rang bzhin rdo rje dang / snying rje chen po thabs kyi rang bzhin gzhon nu sku can gyi las tshogs/

drag po'i gtor ma zor du 'phangs pa'i cho ga la brten nas pha rol dgra bgegs kyi gnod pa bzlog par byed pa'i tshul go bde ba'i ngag gis cung zad tsam brjod pa'i dbang du byas na/ don tshan rnam pa gsum ste/ sbyor ba rten dang yo byad bshams pa/ dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i tshul/ rjes drag po'i las dngos bstan pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gnas khang bla ma gong mas byin gyis brlabs pa sogs ji ltar 'os pa'i sa phyogs de nyid phyag bdar bya ba dang / bla ma yi dam gyi lha/ chos skyong ba'i srung ma la sogs pa rnams kyi rten bris 'bur gang yang rung ba bzhugs su gsol pa'i mdun du stegs bu ji ltar rigs par mchod rdzas ba liṃ gtor ma/ bdud rtsi sman/ rak+ta rnams bshams par byas te/ de nas sgrub pa po rang nyid la sogs pa'i mdun du rdul tshon nam ras la chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum mthing nag gnas khang sogs dang bstun pa'i che chung ji ltar 'tshams pa bris pa'i dbus su lha gnas 'khor lo ser po rtse mo shin tu rno ba'i rnam pa can rtsibs bcu pa'i lte bar chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag kha gyer ljang khu la rdo rje rwa bas mtshan pa/ nang gi zla gam dmar po/ de'i dbus su rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ kha dog sngon po rwa gdengs pa/ chos 'byung gi rtse mo'i ngos su pad nyi'i gdan dang bcas pa bri/ 'khor lo'i bar mtshams rnams phyogs mdog bya ba'am yang na nam mkha'i mdog can du bya bar yang gsungs la/ de lta bu'i 'khor lo'i dbus kyi chos 'byung 'di nyid kyi rtse mo sgrub pa po'i phyogs su ston pa dang / lho phyogs su ston pa'i phyag len gnyis shig yod pa las/ dang po ni bdag gi bla ma sngags 'chang grags pa'i mtshan can de nyid kyi sku tshe'i stod kyi phyag len 'khrul med yin te/ de'i skabs ras gzhi la phyag bris su mdzad pa rnams la'ang de bzhin du 'byung zhing / 'di'i dgongs pa ni stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i skabs kyi 'khor lo'i dbus kyi chos 'byung gi bri lugs dang /

sgom don gnyis dang / 'di'i skabs kyi 'khor lo'i dbus kyi chos 'byung gi bri sgom gnyis la khyad par cung zad kyang med pa la dgongs par mngon pas shin tu 'thad cing legs pa'i phyogs yin la/ yang bdag nyid chen po 'di nyid sku tshe'i smad kyi phyag len la skabs gar dbus kyi chos 'byung gi rtse mo lho phyogs su ston par mdzad pa yang rang nyid gtso gtor dang dbyer med kyi rdo rje gzhon nur sgom pa de'i tshe/ de'i bzhugs gnas kyi chos 'byung gi gnas lugs kyang rnal 'byor pa'i zhal lta phyogs kyi dbang gis de ltar du don gyis thob pa la dgongs pa yin nam snyam mo/ /gang ltar chos 'byung 'khor lo dang bcas pa de'i khar mañdzi chen po'i steng du rdo rje gzhon nu'i gtor ma zur gsum pa'i tha ma la hūm̐ mdzad la sogs pa'i khro bcu'i gtor ma zur gsum pas bskor ba dang / stong pa nyid mtshon byed chos 'byung phyi ma che ba de'i rtse mo 'jig rten pa'i lhor bstan pa'i rtsa ngos su dam can shwa na ma bzhi'i gtor ma/ de'i yang lhor bdud rgyal thod 'phreng can gyi gtor ma la dar nag btsugs pa/ chos 'byung gi nub byang mtshams kyi zur du sa bdag ma bzhi'i gtor ma/ chos 'byung gi byang shar mtshams kyi zur du bdag nyid ma bzhi rnams kyi gtor ma ste/ de rnams kyi dbyibs kyang smad zlum po la stod zur gsum pa'i rnam pa can la tshe dang yungs kar gyi gang bu dang / thod skam dang rgyu rlon skyer rtsangs la sogs pas lag len ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin rgyan gyis brgyan pa'i mtha' skor du chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba can gyi me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas te mchod pa lnga/ mtshams 'dzin gyi me tog dang bcas pa rnams khor yug tu 'khor mar bshams/ der ma zad gzhan yang de'i mtha' skor du liṅga che ba khru gang tsam pa gcig la mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam bcus bskor ba lcags snod lta bu zhig tu bzhag pa la/

liṅga che ba de'i ske la bal tshon sngo dmar 'dres pa can gyi zhags pas bcings pa'i rtse mor phur bu chung du btags te bzhag pa dang / thun rdzas kyi bye brag yungs kar yungs nag lcags zangs bzhu ba 'dres pa'i rdo dreg gi phye ma/ khrag thun mi'i khrag sogs thod pa mtshan ngan du blug pa/ mda' zor ni dug shing gi mde'u can gyi mda' la hūm̐ bh+yoḥphaṭ zhes pa'i yi ge rnams bris pa dang / rdo zor ni shin tu rtsub pa'i dur khrod kyi rdo la hūm̐ bh+yoḥphaṭ gsum gyi sngags gong bzhin bris pa/ mda' rdo gnyis ka dug khrag gis byugs pa/ gzhan yang rwa zor byed na glang ngam g.yag 'brus te 'og yod pa'i rwa g.yas kyi nang du dug khrag nus pa can blug pa/ de'i kha re ba ste sbra tshal nag pos bcad cing / skyer pa ser po'i phur pa dang / tshon skud kyis kha dam du bcings pa rnams mngon par 'du byas la bzhag liṅga'i rgyu ni da lta phyag len la bag zan la rgyu byas pa ste bag phye zhib mor thug gi gcin dang lug thug gi dri chus sbrus/ de la gad pa nag po chad pa'i sa dang / mi phung shul gyi sa sna bsres pa rnams la mdzad pa/ spyir btang rgyud las gsungs tshul tsam gyi dbang du byas na/ gsang rgyud las/ grog mkhar sa dang mi phung sa/ /gas kyi dum bu bū rtsi'i phub/ /srub ma'i 'o ma zhing chen ras/ /sne tshe dang ni ldong ros dang / /thal chen dang ni rak+ta dang / /bshang pa dang ni gci ba dang / /bcu gnyis thod pa'i nang du brdungs/ /kī la ya dang mud ka ra/ /a ki ta ya hūm̐ phaṭ ces/ /ra thug lug thug gcin gyis sbrus/ /zhes gsungs la/ yang rgyud kyi lung 'grel chen 'bum nag tu drangs pa las/ dkyil 'khor dang ni 'brub khung gnyis/ /so so yin te mi gcig go /liṅga dang ni nya bo gnyis/ /dmigs pa gcig ste rgyu mi gcig /liṅga nya po'i snying gar gzhug /ces pa dang / grog mkhar sa dang rkang rjes sa/ /phyi sa dri chu gos dum rnams/

/nya bo bya ba'i rdzas su bshad/ /shun chen gro kha shog shog rnams/ /liṅga bri ba'i rdzas su bshad/ /ces sogs rgyas par gsungs pa'i don gyi snying po ni liṅga la srog can srog med gnyis/ srog med la gdab ba'i liṅga/ btab pa'i liṅga/ gzir ba'i liṅga gsum las 'dir gdab pa'i liṅga'i rgyu rnams bsags te mngon par 'du bya ba yin la/ de nas rnal 'byor sgrub pa po rang nyid kyi grogs dang bcas pa rnams rigs dang bslab pa dang / yon tan sogs skabs su bab pa'i gral la rim pa bzhin 'khod pa'i rang rang gi mdun du rol mo'i bye brag rdo rje dril bu ka pā la bdud rtsis gang ba'i nang mchod dang bcas pa/ ḍā ma ru/ sil snyan/ rnga/ dung / cha lang sogs dang / gzhan yang / bsnyen phur/ sras mchog rigs lnga'i phur pa/ 'og bsgral mchod kyi skabs su dgos pa'i gdab phur bcu bdun/ phur pa de rnams la mthu bskyed pa'i rdzas yungs dkar nag ngar bskyed pa'i gu gul la sogs pa'i rdzas rnams bshams la de nas dngos gzhi la 'jug par bya ba yin no zhes pa de rnams kyis sbyor ba rten dang mchod pa gshom tshul gyi don rnams bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa sogs la 'jug tshul bshad pa la yang / sngon 'gro'i cho ga gnas yo byin rlabs sogs bshad pa dang / dngos gzhi'i cho ga ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i tshul bshad pa/ rjes kyi cho ga zor rdzas byin rlabs sogs bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po la gnas yo byin rlabs bshad pa dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs bshad pa gnyis kyi dang po ni/ gzhung las/ rdo rje'i rtses mchod pa rnams la nang mchod gtor te zhes pa nas/ rnga byin dbab rgyas 'bring bsdus pa skabs dang bstun pa bgyis nas zhes pa'i bar te/ de dag gi don yang sgrub pa pos rdo rje'i rtses mchod pa'i yo byad rnams la nang mchod gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra krodha a mri ta kuṇ+ḍa li hūm̐ tshin+dha tshin+dha hūm̐ phaṭ/

ces brjod cing de'i tshe ting nge 'dzin ni rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i thugs ka nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa spros te/ de dag gis gnas khang mchod rdzas dang bcas pa'i gdon bgegs rnams bskrad de bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dhar+m+ma swā bhā ba shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod de gnas yo rnams kyi 'bags grib dang / tha mal du snang ba'i rnam rtog gi tshogs thams cad sbyangs/ de ltar gang du'ang ma grub pa stong pa nyid kyi ngang las sgrub khang ngam gnas khang 'di nyid drag po'i las kyi gzhal yas khang ste/ de yang sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes sa skya pa'i bka' srung dam can rnams kyi thugs dam bskang ba'i cho ga dngos grub rgya mtsho las/ mi mgo'i rtsig pa lcang lo'i kha bad can/ /zhes pa nas/ me rlung 'khrug pa drag po'i gnas khang 'di/ /zhes pa'i bar du gsungs pa ltar gyi/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang du mchod pa'i rdzas rnams kyi snod a yig yongs su bsgyur pa las byung ba'i ban+da 'bar ba'i snod shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba stong gsum gyi tshad dang mnyam par mchod rdzas rang gi ngo bo gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams bsgral ba'i sha khrag gi ar+ghaṃ ste mchod yon/ de bzhin du dgra bgegs rnams kyi mig rna ba/ rna/ lce/ lus kyi dbang po'i mchog tu gyur ba snying ste/ dbang po lnga'i me tog dang / gzhan yang tshil chen te dgra bo'i tshil bu'i bdug spos/ zhun chen te rkang mar gyi sgron me/ 'khris pa zhu mar gyur pa'i dri chab/ gzhan yang / sha chen dang rus chen gyi tshogs kyi zhal zas/ rkang gling dang thod rnga la sogs pa'i rol mo'i tshogs te/ mchod pa'i bye brag de thams cad kyang sprin gyi phung po chen po 'thibs pa ltar bsam gyis mi khyab cing blo'i yul las 'das pa zhig mchod pa'i yul dam pa rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo/

gzhan yang rgyal ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas sras byang chub sems dpa'/ slob ma nyan rang dang bcas pa rnams kyi spyan lam du thogs pa med par 'byung shing rgya cher rgyas par gyur cig snyam du smon pa dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra ā ha ra li hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ badz+ra bid pu ra ya hūm̐ phaṭ zhes pa'i bar brjod cing sngags phyag rgya ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis gnas yo byin rlabs byas la/ de nas rnga byin dbab rgyas pa'i rgyas pa/ rgyas pa'i bsdus pa/ 'bring po'i rgyas pa/ 'bring po'i bsdus pa/ bsdus pa'i rgyas pa/ bsdus pa'i bsdus pa ste drug po rol yig mthong ba rang grol nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin dus skabs dang bstun la legs par bgyis pas byin dbab pa phyag len bzhin byas nas/ de nas bdag bskyed kyi sngon 'gro'i chos dngos/ gnyis pa skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs bshad pa ni/ gzhung las skyabs 'gro ci rigs pa dang / zhes sogs nas/ mchod rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa rnams bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar ste/ de dag gi don yang skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur gsal ba'i sgo nas skyabs 'gro bzhi skor yun tshad ji ltar rigs pa dang / rdo rje slob dpon sangs rgyas dpal/ /dus gsum bzhugs la zhes sogs kyi yan lag bdun pa bya ba nas/ mtshams bcad pa/ bshags pa bya ba/ byin dbab pa/ mchod rdzas sman raka gtor gsum byin gyis brlabs pa rnams sgrub thabs ltar bya zhing / de dag gi tshig don rnams ni kho bos byas pa'i rnam bshad chen mo 'phrin las kyi pad+mo rab tu rgyas byed du bshad pa ltar yin la/ de dag gis ni sngon 'gro'i cho ga gnas yo byin rlabs dang / skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sogs bstan zin pa yin la/ da ni gnyis pa dngos gzhi'i cho ga ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i tshul bshad pa la/ bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i tshul dang / bsrung bzlog gsad gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i tshul sogs gnyis las/

dang po ni gzhung las gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i tshul ni zhes pa nas/ bstod pa'i bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa bzhin byas la zhes pa'i bar te/ de dag gi don yang / gnyis pa dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i tshul ni sgrub pa po rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nu'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas lha'i nga rgyal dang / mdun gyi gtso gtor sogs gtor ma rnams rang dang gnyis su med pa'i phur pa'i lha tshogs su gsal bar mos pa'am de ltar du bskyed pa la/ dang po rang gi sems ma bcos pa zhes sogs ting nge 'dzin rnam pa gsum sgom pa nas khaṃ spros pas chus bkrus/ /skyon thams cad dag par byas/ /zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa bklags pas don 'grub bzhin ngag tu brjod pa dang / don bsam pa rnams lung gi sgo gsum mam bzhi dang ldan par byas la/ de nas 'byung ba lnga'i sa bon sogs spro ba'i skabs/ e/ yaṃ/ waṃ/ raṃ/ laṃ ste 'byung ba lnga'i sa bon dang / raṃ kaṃ ste rak+ta'i rba klong dang / keng rus sa gzhi'i sa bon gyi rjes su gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang 'brel ba'i tshe 'byung ba'i bh+ruṃ zhes pa'i gzhal yas khang gi sa bon de dor la/ e bh+ruṃ zhes pas 'khor lo rtsibs bcu lte ba'i chos 'byung dang bcas pa'i sa bon rnams s+pha ra ṇa phaṭ zhes pas rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin gyi hūm̐ las gong gi sa bon dgu po spros te rang rang gi gnas su gsal gdab/ e ā k+ṣa sha maṇ+ḍa la zhes pa la sogs pa nas/ keṃ mahā kaṃ ka la su me ru maṇ+ḍa la zhes pa'i bar/ 'byung ba lnga rak+ta keṃ rus rnams gsal byed tshig gi sgo dang / dmigs pa yid kyi sgo dang / gsang ba sngags kyi sgo rnams kyi sgo nas nyams su len tshul rnams/ gzhal yas khang bskyed pa dang 'brel ba ltar byas la/ sa bon gyi skabs su gzhal yas khang gi sa bon dor ba ltar/ bh+ruṃ bi shud+dhe dz+wa la maṇ+ḍa la zhes pas gzhal yas khang bskyed pa'i sngags kyi sgo dang / bh+ruṃ las rin chen sna lnga'i rang bzhin las/

/zhes sogs gzhal yas khang brjod pa tshig gi sgo nas gsal gdab pa rnams kyang dor bar bya ba yin la/ des na skabs 'dir kaṃ mahā kaṃ ka la su me ru maṇ+ḍa la zhes pa'i mjug de ma thag par e tri ko na sogs sbyar ba dang / de bzhin du/ keṃ las keng rus ri rab brtsegs pa'i steng / /bh+ruṃ las gser mdog 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ /zhes sogs sbrel te sbyar bar bya ba yin zhing / mdun bskyed kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa yan gyi 'bru gnyer go don rnams rnam bshad chen mo nas 'byung ba ltar nges par byas nas/ de nas bh+ruṃ las gser mdog 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa/ /zhes sogs kyi don rnams cung zad bkrol na/ keng rus kyi ri rab sngo mkhregs su gyur pa du ma brtsegs pa'i steng der/ bar snang gi hūm̐ yig las 'chad pa'i bh+ruṃ yig yongs su gyur pa las/ gser btso ma'i mdog can gyi 'khor lo rtsibs kyi grangs bcu dang ldan par gyur pa/ de'i khog pa'i gseng rnams stong pa shin tu yangs shing rgya che ba la/ phyi'i rtse mo dang zur rnams shin tu ngar ba'i rno dbal dang ldan pas dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams kyi lus rdul phran gyi phye ma ltar rlog par byed la/ 'khor lo de las rab tu tsha zhing 'bar ba'i me lce'i glog 'phreng dang 'od stong phyogs bcur 'gyu ba ste 'phro bar byed pa 'gal me'i 'khor lo ltar shin tu myur ba 'khor ba'i ngang tshul lam/ rang bzhin can gyi 'khor lo ri rab ltar brtan zhing gzi brjid dang ldan pa/ 'khor lo de'i lte ba'i dbus su e yig yongs su gyur pa las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum pa kha dog mthing nag me 'bar ba'i mu khyud la rdo rje rwa bas rnam par mdzes shing spras pa/ 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa de'i phyi rol phyogs mtshams brgyad du dur khrod brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ zhing skyong brgyad/ klu brgyad/ me brgyad/

chu brgyad/ grub chen brgyad/ shing brgyad la sogs pa bskyed cing sgom pa nas bzung ste dkyil 'khor gsum bskyed pa/ sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor spyan drangs ba/ phyi mchod/ bdud rtsi sman mchod/ gsang mchod/ bsgral mchod/ gtor ma'i mchod pa/ bstod pa rgyas pa rnams kyis bstod pa'i bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin nyams su blang bar bya ba yin la/ de dag gi sgom don rnams ni rnam bshad chen mo nas 'byung ba bzhin rang rang gi blo nus dang sbyar te spro bar bya'o/ /skabs 'dir dpyod ldan rnams la dogs gnas 'jug tshul cung zad brjod na/ gong sbyor ba'i skabs su bshad pa'i mdun gyi rdul mtshon rnams ras bris kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bcu'i 'og gzhir gyur pa'i chos 'byung mthing nag kha sgyer me ris dang bcas pa de nyid/ sgrub thabs kyi skabs su bskyed chog gsal ba gang yang ma byung ba ji ltar yin snyam na/ gzhung du tshig zin la gsal bar mi bzhugs kyang / sgom don la keṃ rus kyi ri rab kyi steng du e'am khaṃ las byung ba gnam lcags sogs las grub pa'i chos 'byung gru gsum mthing nag gting zab cing rgya che ba ye shes kyi me 'bar zhing tsha tsha phyogs kun tu 'phro ba zhig cis kyang sgom dgos par sems te/ drag po mngon spyod kyi las sgrub pa'i lha rnams kyi bzhugs gnas kyi 'og gzhir chos 'byung ngam lcags kyi khang sgrom nag po sgo med zur gsum pa de lta bu sgom dgos pa rje btsun gong ma'i man ngag gi yig cha du ma las gsungs pa yin te/ gur gyi mgon po'i dmar chen gtor bzlog gi phyag len rgyas pa'i skabs dang / mgon po drug cu pa'i mdun bskyed kyi skabs sogs su de ltar du bshad pa dang gnad gcig pa'i phyir ro/ /dper na stod las byang chub sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor rdul mtshon gyis bri ba'i tshe yang sgrub thabs su tshig zin gsal bar med kyang dur khrod kyi phyi la chos 'byung mtshon byed rdul mtshon dmar skya'i bcad bya bar gsungs pa dang tshul mtshungs pa yin la/

stod las kyi skabs su de ltar mdzad pa'i dgongs pa yang sngon rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud gsungs pa'i tshe chos 'byung gi nang du chud pa'i gzhal yas khang sprul nas der rgyud gsungs pa tshad ldan gyi yig cha las bshad pas na/ sngon byung ston pa'i rnam 'phrul de/ /rjes 'jug sgrub po'i nyams len yin/ /zhes pa'i dgongs pa'i don bla na med pa yin la/ yang bri cha la med kyang sgom don la dgos pa'i gnas skabs kyang du ma snang ste/ 'di'i stod las kyi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor yug tu bstan ma bcu gnyis sogs sgom pa dang / gtor bzlog gi skabs 'dir yang dur khrod brgyad bri cha la med kyang sgom dgos pa gzhung nyid la gsal bar bzhugs pa sogs 'di 'dra'i rigs can mang du 'byung bas skyes sbyangs kyi blo mig mchog dang ldan pa rnams kyis dgongs 'tshal lo/ /yang blo ldan rnams la dogs gnas 'di ltar yang 'byung ste/ stod las kyi skabs su sgo ma rnams sgom pa'i gnas dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhir yin yang / skabs 'dir sgo'i rnam gzhag ma bshad pas gang du sgom pa'i gnas dang / bskyed pa'i tshig sgrub thabs bklags pas don grub nas 'byung ba bzhin gyi/ shar phyogs sgo srung gnod sbyin mo zhes sogs kyis bskyed pa yang cung zad mi bde ba ma yin nam snyam na bshad par bya ste/ skabs 'dir sgo bzhi med pas/ sgo ma bzhi gang du sgom pa'i gnas ni shar phyogs kyi khro bo rnam rgyal dang / lho phyogs kyi gshin rje gshed dang / nub phyogs kyi rta mgrin dang / byang phyogs kyi bdud rtsi 'khyil pa rnams bzhugs sa'i 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi rtse mor sgom dgos pa yin te/ sa lo 'jam pa'i rdo rjes rin chen rtse'i gnyer pa'i dri lan las/ gzhal yas khang mi sgom par 'khor lo rkyang pa sgom dus phyogs bzhi'i 'khor lo'i rtser sgo ma rnams sgom dgos pa yin zhes gsungs pas so/

/'di la bdag chen rgya gar bas gtor bzlog dgra bgegs kun 'joms kyi bdag mdun tha mi dad chen po'i sgo nas lha bskyed pa'i skabs su 'di ltar gsungs te/ mdun gyi drag gtor bcu gcig po rnams lhar bskyed pa dang bdag nyid dbyer med du byas la/ dbus su bdag nyid khro bo'i rgyal po zhes sogs gtso bo yab yum/ khro bo bcu/ phra men nyi shu/ sgo ma bzhi ma bskyed kyang chog snyam/ gal te bskyed na sgo srung zhes pa 'don pa bsgyur la/ shar phyogs 'gugs byed ces dang / 'ching byed/ sdom byed/ dbang byed zhes sbyar/ de nas bstod pa yan chad sgrub thabs ltar ro/ /zhes gsungs pas sgo ma bzhi bskyed pa'i tshig 'don pa bsgyur kyang rung ba yin la/ bdag chen rgya gar ba'i bzlog gzhung der sgo ma bzhi ma bskyed kyang chog pa lta bu gsungs pa de ni/ sgo ma bzhi phyogs bzhi'i 'khor lo'i rtser yid kyis bsgom nas bskyed pa'i tshig sgrub thabs bklags pa don 'grub kyi tshig rigs dngos bstan bzhin gyis ma bskyed kyang chog pa la dgos pa yin gyi/ dmigs pa ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo ni/ sgo srung bzhi cis kyang sgom dgos te/ 'og nas 'byung ba'i bstod bskul/ zor rdzas byin rlabs/ bzlog bskul sogs thams cad la sgo ma bzhi bskul pa 'byung bas so/ /bskyed pa'i tshig sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar gyis shar phyogs sgo srung / lho phyogs sgo srung zhes sogs kyi tshig brjod pa la'ang mi bde ba'i dogs pa nam yang dgos pa ma yin te/ dper na gur mgon lha bcu gnyis ma'i dbang bskur ba'i tshe/ sgo ma bzhi dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhir bskyed pa yin kyang / rjes gnang gi skabs su sgo ma bzhi bskyed pa na/ shar phyogs kyi sgo skyong ma dzaḥlas seng gdong ma dkar mo/ lho phyogs kyi sgo skyong ma hūm̐ las gzig gdong ma ser mo/ nub phyogs kyi sgo skyong ma baṃ las dom gdong ma dmar mo/

byang phyogs kyi sgo skyong ma ho las dred gdong ma nag mo zhes sogs gdong ma bzhi la sgo skyong ma zhes pa'i tshig sbyar nas brjod kyang 'gal ba med pa dang gnad cig pa'i phyir/ des na gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi sgom pa'i tshe sgo bzhir bzhugs pa'i lha de rnams/ skabs 'dir shar phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi rtse mo sogs gnas de dang der bzhugs pa yin no snyam du bsam zhing / tshig rnams brjod cing gsal 'debs pa yin pas/ des na sgrub thabs kyi gzhung gzhan du tshig gis bskyed pa la mi bde bar ci zhig dogs/ de ltar dpyod ldan gzur gnas rnams kyi mkhyen par mdzod cig cung zad 'phros pa'o/ /de rnams kyis bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi ting nge 'dzin sgom tshul 'phros don cung zad dang bcas pa bshad zin nas/ gnyis pa bsrung bzlog gsad gsum gyi ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i tshul sogs ni/ gzhung las bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni zhes pa nas/ bskang bshags dang bstod pa ji ltar rigs pa byas nas zhes pa'i bar te/ de dag gi don yang gong du bstan pa ltar bzlas pa'i bar gyi sgrub thabs kyi tshig don rnams rdzogs par nyams su blangs te/ de nas bzlas pa'i dmigs pa bya ba'i tshul la/ bsrung bzlog gsad gsum las dang po bsrung ba'i dmigs pa ni dper na dmag dpon dpa' bo g.yul du 'jug pa na go mtshon bzang po tshags su chud pa gnad du che ba ltar/ dgra bgegs gdug pa can drag po mngon spyod kyi las kyi sgo nas bzlog par byed pa la bsrung ba'i dmigs pa gal che bas/ de la rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba dam tshig sems dpa'i snying khar ye shes sems dpa' mtshon gang pa/ de'i thugs khar rdo rje sngon po nas 'bru tsam pa rtse lnga pa'i lte bar rnal 'byor pa rang gi sems ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ yig kha dog sngon po 'od dang 'od zer du ma 'bar ba'i rnam pa can/ klad kor gyi nang du rtsa ba'i bla ma sogs bla ma zhal dngos su bzhugs pa rnams kyi mtshan rgya skad dang bod skad gang ltar na'ang da lta dngos su grags pa'i mtshan yig dang po ste de yang /

brtsegs pa'i thog ma bsgrigs pa'i dbus/ /zhes pa ltar rdo rje lta bu'i ra dang / bsod nams lta bu'i sa la thig les brgyan pa/ hūm̐ gi mdun du rang gi pha dang ma/ hūm̐ gi g.yas su bu dang chung ma lta bu/ hūm̐ gi g.yon du spun zla/ hūm̐ gi rgyab tu 'khor g.yog hūm̐ gi zhabs kyu'i nang du rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa'ang man ngag 'ga' zhig las bshad la/ hūm̐ gi 'og tu nor rdzas rnams yod par bsam la/ de nas rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas bsrung bya gang yin pa de rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum thams cad bkug la sngar gyi gnas rnams su 'khod par sgom/ slar yang 'od zer de rnams kyis rang dang bsrung bya gang yin pa de dag gi nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad phyir gtor nas dag par byas te lus thams cad rdo rje'i go cha gyon te go mtshams med par bltams par bsam pa ni lus bsrung ba yin la/ yang rang gi lce hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa dang de'i ra rnams la kī la ya'i sngags 'phreng mgo gyen bstan sgreng tshar du bkod pa de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi ngag gi nyes skyon thams cad byang zhing dag par bsam pa ni ngag bsrung ba yin la/ slar yang snying ga'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ sngon po de rang dang bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bor bsam pa ni yid bsrung ba ste de dag ni bsrung ba'i dmigs pa yin la/ gnyis pa bzlog pa'i dmigs pa ni yang rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas khro bo bcu/ khro mo bcu/ khra thabs nyi shu/ sgo ma bzhi/ phur srung dam can bcu gnyis rnams bskul te lha tshogs de dag las sprul pa yang sprul nying sprul tshad med grangs med dpag tu med pa spros nas/ sdang dgra gnod bgegs rnams kyi lus ngag yid gsum dang bcas pa rnams rdul phran gyi phye ma ltar byas shing /

khro bo khro mo phra thabs sgo ma dam can rnams kyang zhal phyir gzigs te dgra bgegs kyi gnod pa thams cad phyir bzlog pa'i las mdzad/ gser mdog 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa yang g.yon du myur du 'khor bar bsam pa ni bzlog pa'i dmigs pa mdor bsdus te bstan pa yin la/ gsum pa gsad pa'i dmigs pa ni phyogs mtshams kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs bar rnams su 'og tu yaṃ las rlung drag po g.yo ba dang / de'i steng du raṃ las me 'bar ba'i steng du dgra bgegs dmigs yul gang yin pa de nyid la sogs pa de dag rnam pa byad ma lus rid pa/ skra dang ba spu sogs 'dzings pa/ kha la sogs pa bu ga dgu nas khrag 'dzag cing skyug pa/ lus spyi bo tshugs su gnas pa rtsibs bar rnams su re re bsams la de'i tshe rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i pho nya phyag tu lcags kyu dang zhags pa dang lcags sgrog la sogs pa thogs pa'i tshogs mang po spros nas sdang dgra gnod bgegs gang na gnas pa'i phyogs dang yul nas de dag gi gzugs dang rnam par shes pa rang dbang med par 'khor lo'i rtsibs kyi nye ba'i char bkug te rtsibs bar gyi byad ma rnams la gnyis su med par bstim/ rnal 'byor pa rang dang bsrung bya gang yin pa de'i nad gdon sdig sgrib bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byad ma rnams kyi kha la sogs pa'i lus kyi bu ga dgu nas dud khu'i rnam pas nag thib thib thim ste zhugs pas de'i rkyen gyis 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams g.yon skor du myur du 'khor/ de ltar 'khor bas 'og gi rlung dang me 'bar bas bskyod cing 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams shin tu rno ba'i ral gri'i so lta bus gnod byed dgra bgegs rnams kyi sha khrag rus gsum gyis bsdus pa'i lus thams cad dum bu dum bur btubs sha khrag rnams la sprul pa'i pho nya rnams kyis zos shing mid de shul tsam yang mi dmigs par brlag par byas par bsam pa 'di dag ni gsad pa'i dmigs pa'o/

/de nas bzlas pa dngos la 'jug pa'i skabs hūm̐ badz+ra dz+nyā na kī li kī la ya zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis ye shes sems dpa' rang dam tshig sems dpa' dang 'dra ba la 'on kyang yum med pa cig rang gi mdun du phyung la/ de nas dz+nyā na satwa e tri ko na ces sogs brjod pa'i dus rang dam tshig sems dpa'/ snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa'/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' ste sems dpa' gsum brtsegs de nyid gsal gdab par byas nas/ sngags brjod pa'i tshe ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' las kī la ya'i sngags 'phreng nar gyis byung ba ye shes sems dpa' dang rang gnyis kyi sna bug g.yas gnyis nas 'thon/ rang gi mdun gyi char bzhugs pa'i ye shes sems dpa' de'i shangs bug g.yon nas zhugs te thugs kha'i hūm̐ la thim/ slar yang hūm̐ de las kī la ya'i sngags 'phreng 'od zer 'phro ba dang bcas pa byung ste/ mdun gyi ye shes sems dpa' de nyid kyi shangs bug gam sna bug g.yas nas 'thon/ rang nyid rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i rang gi sna bug g.yon nas zhugs te snying ga'i ye shes sems dpa' dang ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ de nyid la thim/ de yang sngags 'phreng phyir 'gro ba'i dus su rang 'dra'i sprul pa grangs med pa dpag tu med pa spros nas mkha' khyab sems can thams cad kyi rgyu dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i las ngan pa thams cad tshar bcad/ bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs rdzogs te rdo rje gzhon nu'i ngo bor gyur par bsam zhing / sngags 'phreng rnams nang du 'ong ba'i dus su phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang nus mthu rdzu 'phrul thams cad rang la sib kyis thim pas rang gzi brjid nus mthu thams cad rgyas par bsam/ rang sems dpa' gsum brtsegs kyi bdag nyid can gyis sngags bzlas pa'i dus su bdag mdun tha mi dad kyi khro bo khro mo/

khra thabs nyi shu/ sgo ma bzhi/ dam can bcu gnyis rnams dang / sgeg cing ma sogs kyi skabs su mdun du spyan drangs pa'i sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ yi dam gyi skur gyur pa thams cad kyis kyang rang gi bzlas pa'i grogs mdzad par bsams te kī la ya la sogs pa'i sngags kyi sgra 'brug gi sgra ltar grag par bsam la gtso bo rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum gyi sngags nas brtsams te dbang phyug ma'i bh+yo'i bar sgrub thabs rgyas pa'i gzhung nas 'byung ba bzhin bzlas pa'i mthar/ gzhi rnying gcig tu dril ba'i sngags/ ma rak+mo/ ya rak+mo/ kā la ru pa sogs kyi sngags 'di nyid dang / bha ya na ci nus pa bzlas pa'i mthar/ lag pa thal mo sbyar nas ngag tu/ na mo rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi bka' bden pa dang zhes sogs brjod de/ de dag gi don yang na mo zhes spyir phyag 'tshal nas/ gang bya na khyed rnams kyi bden pa'i mthu stobs kyis dgra bgegs rnams zhi bar mdzod cig ces bskul/ gang dang gang la phyag 'tshal nas bskul na/ dbang bzhi bskur ba'i sgo nas tshe 'dir mchog gi dngos grub rtsol bar mdzod pa'i bka' drin can rje btsun rtsa ba'i bla ma dang / chos sku kun tu bzang po nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar du brgyud pa bar ma chad du nus mthu dang bcas pa sha stag tu byon pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyis yang nas yang du bka' bden par stsal ba'i mthu dang / spangs rtogs mthar phyin sangs rgyas dkon mchog lung rtogs bdag nyid chos dkon mchog rigs grol gnyis ldan dge 'dun dkon mchog khyad par lhag pa'i lha mchog bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs/ dpal chen thugs las sprul pa'i khro bcu yab yum/ yang sprul dgra bgegs 'dul mdzad phra thabs nyi shu/ las bzhi'i phrin las skyong mdzad sgo ma rnam bzhi/

dpal chen thugs kyi sras mchog phur bu rigs lnga/ dam can bka'i bya ra srung ma bcu gnyis/ myur mgyogs drag po'i las mdzad 'khor tshogs rnams kyi bka' bden pa'i mthu dang / dbyings spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba bden pa chen po'i byin rlabs kyis mthu dang nus pas rnal 'byor pa bdag cag gi rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa chos kyi spyan ldan rnams dang / bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod grogs mched 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la snying thag pa nas zhe sdang pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / yid gdug rtsub kyi sgo nas gnod par 'dod pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag po'i brtul zhugs kyi sgo nas gnod pa skyel bar 'dod pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / de dag la sogs pa mdor na bsam pa ngan pa dang / sbyor ba rtsub pa'i ngang tshul can gyis gzhan la ngan sems 'chang pa'i dgra bgegs gang yin pa de dag thams cad kyi g.yo 'gul byed pa'i lus/ smra brjod byed pa'i ngag tshul min yid byed kyi dran rtog 'gyu ba'i yid rnams man ngag zab mo'i cho ga 'di'i byin rlabs dang skyabs gnas rnams kyi bden pa'i mthu stobs kyis bcings par bgyi'o/ /gdug pa can de dag thams cad kyi gnod par byed pa'i nus mthu/ ya ma zung gi rdzu 'phrul/ rtsal dang stobs rnams brlag par gyur cig gnod byed des bzlas pa'i ngan sngags kyi nus mthus gnod byed de nyid rang brlag par gyur cig gnod byed des ngan sems kyi sgo nas bsgrubs pa'i lha dang 'dre la sogs pa rnams kyis kyang gnod byed de nyid rang gi sha khrag rus gsum 'thung zhing za bar gyur cig ces pa'i don can gyi smod tshig ngag tu brjod cing / mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rgyud las/ hūm̐ gis dregs byas phyag rgyas gdab/ /rdo rje 'tshir bas 'tshir ba nyid/ /ces gsungs pa ltar lag pa thal mo brdabs la/ rje sa chen gyi gsungs rab las/

bdag nyid kyi thugs ka nas khro bo rang 'dra ba mtshon cha thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te gnod byed thams cad kyi lce bcad cing lus mgo nas bshang lam gyi bar du gtubs bshags shing / lus rdul phran tsam du byas nas mes bsregs/ rlung gis gtong bar bsam/ zhes gsungs pa dang / rje btsun gyi ṭīk+ka gur rgyan las/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthil du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje bsgom/ sor mo rnams kyang rdo rje'i rang bzhin du bsams la/ lag pa gnyis thal mo brdabs pa'i bar du bgegs 'tshir bar bsam/ zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi sems kyi ting nge 'dzin de lta bu dang ldan pas gnod byed kyi tshogs thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du song bar dmigs la/ khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /zhes sogs brjod cing de'i don yang / khro bo hūm̐ ka ra la sogs pa ye shes kyi me phung chen po 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'i lha tshogs khyed rnams kyis mthu stobs kyi sgo nas gzugs can gyi dgra dang gzugs med kyi bgegs rnams ni gang yin pa de thams cad kyi lus dang ngag gnyis thal ba'i rdul phran shin tu cha phra ba bzhin du rlog la/ sems rnam par shes pa ni spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i chos kyi dbyings su rang ngo shes pa'i sgo nas 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i las mdzod cig ces pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba'i smon pa'i tshig brjod la/ srung ba'i 'khor lo de nyid byang chub ma thob bar du brtan par bya ba'i phyir du/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ zhes pa lan gsum brjod de/ de'ang oṃ ni dam bca' ba/ gang dam bca' na bsrung bar dam bca'/ gang gis bsrung na badz+ra te rdo rjes srung / gang bsrung na rak+ṣa sogs te/ rak+ṣa dang pos gnas/ rak+ṣa gnyis pas rnal 'byor/ hūm̐ gsum gyis bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum ste/ mdor na bdag gnas rnal 'byor gsum bsrung zhing / phaṭ ces pas phyin chad bgegs kyis mi tshugs shing slar bgegs rnams 'joms byed srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par byed pa gsang sngags gsar ma'i lugs nas bshad pa rnams dang mthun par snang la/

gtor bzlog 'di nyid zhag du ma sbrel nas byed pa ltar na nub dang po rnams la skabs 'dir brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs lam rim smon lam dang bcas pa'i rjes su bcoms rol dbyangs dang bcas pas/ byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas/ /zhes pa la sogs pa'i sgo nas rig 'dzin spyi dang bye brag mthu rtsal myur la bka' drin che ba rnams kyi thugs rje bskul nas/ de nas yi dam kyai rdor bde mchog sogs dang chos skyong gzhan las ches khyad par du 'phags pa'i mchog dang mthun mong gi dngos grub gnyis ka bde blag du stsol nges pa'i rje btsun sa skya pa'i bka' srung mthu rtsal dang nus pa'i mnga' bdag rnams la mchod pa dang gtor ma phul la phyag len dri ma med pas brgyan pa'i bskang bshags dang bstod pa ji ltar rigs pa sogs bya'o/ /de dag gis ni dngos gzhi cho ga'i don rnams bstan zin nas/ gsum pa rjes kyi cho ga zor rdzas byin rlabs sogs bstan pa ni/ /gzhung las/ rjes kyi cho ga la zhes pa nas/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o zhes pa'i bar te/ de dag gi don yang / de nas rjes kyi cho ga la tshogs byin rlabs dang bcas tshogs dang po gnyis kyi rjes su gong du 'dus byas pa'i liṅga rnams gu gul gyi dud pas bdugs la/ rnal 'byor zor 'dzin gyi mdun du bzhag ste/ sgrub pa po rang nyid dpal chen po'i nga rgyal brtan po dang ldan pas lag tu rdor dril thogs nas e raṃ sogs 'og nas 'byung ba ltar gyi dgug gzhug lan gsum byas la liṅga'i steng du sna tshogs rdo rje'am rdo rje byin rlabs dang ldan pa bzhag ste sna tshogs rdo rje dang ri rab kyis mnan pas gang du'ang thar ba med par bsams la/ liṅga'i ske la btags pa'i phur pa gtso bo'i gtor ma la btsugs te bzhag de nas zor rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa la/ dmigs pa sems rtse gcig pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni rang rdo rje gzhon nur gsal ba'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros nas yi dam chos skyong rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul bas de rnams so so'i thugs ka nas kyang 'od zer rab tu mang po spros te zor rdzas gtor ma/

mda' zor/ rdo zor/ thun rdzas/ dug khrag yungs kar nag sogs la phog pas rdzas de rnams dgra bgegs tshar gcod pa'i mthu nus dpag tu med pa dang ldan par bsam la/ 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs kyis/ /zhes sogs zor rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa'i sngags tshig rnams brjod par bya ba yin te/ 'di la don tshan drug ste sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs bye brag spyir bskul ba/ khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs la bskul ba/ dam can shwa na bzhi dang bse'i skyes bu la bskul ba/ gzhan yang chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la bskul ba/ rig 'dzin mthu rtsal can rnams la bskul ba/ zor rdzas nus ldan du mngags shing pho nya drag tu bskul ba dang drug las/ dang po ni/ gzhung las/ 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs kyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bco lngas bstan te/ de dag gi don yang sgrub pa sde brgyad dam bka' brgyad kyi bye brag 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis zor rdzas chen po 'di rnams dang / thun rdzas chen po 'di rnams kyi mthu nus dang rno ngar bskyed la 'di rnams bsnun pa dang 'phangs pa tsam gyis bstan pa spyi dang bye brag la gnod par byed pa'i dgra bgegs gdug pa can rnams tshar gcod pa ste de rnams kyi srog 'phrog pa la sogs pa drag po mngon spyod kyi las la mnga' brnyes pa'i khro bo'i lha tshogs khyed rnams kyis thugs rje dang mthu rtsal gyi dpung bskyed la las 'di myur ba nyid du 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod cig ces pa ste/ de bzhin du pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs kyis/ zor chen sogs kyi don gong bzhin/ yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs kyis/ zor chen sogs kyi don gong bzhin/ bdud rtsi yon tan lha tshogs kyis/ zor chen sogs kyi don gong bzhin/ 'phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs rnams la zor chen sogs kyi don gong bzhin bskul ba de yan gyis sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs kyi bye brag spyir bskul ba bstan zin nas/

gnyis pa khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs la bskul ba ni gzhung las/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang nyer gcig gis bstan te/ de dag gi don yang gong du bstan pa'i lha tshogs de'i nang nas mchog tu gyur pa bcom ldan dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu yis/ /zor chen sogs kyi don gong bzhin/ de dang gnyis med lhun grub tu sbyor ba yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs kyis/ zor chen sogs kyi don gong bzhin/ yab yum gnyis kyi thugs las sprul zhing sdang dgra gnod bgegs rnams 'jigs par byed pa khro bo bcu po yis/ zor chen sogs kyi don gong bzhin/ de rnams dang gnyis med du sbyor ba rdo rje dbyings kyi rang bzhin khro mo bcu bo yis/ zor chen sogs kyi don gong bzhin/ yab yum de rnams las legs par sprul pa'i phra thabs nyi shu yis/ zor chen sogs kyi don gang bzhin/ /ye shes tshad med pa bzhi'i rang bzhin sgo ma chen mo rnam pa bzhi po yis/ zor chen sogs kyi don gong bzhin/ dpal chen thugs kyi sras mchog rgyal ba phur bu rigs lnga yis/ zor chen sogs kyi don gong bzhin/ de yan gyis bye brag rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs la bskul ba bstan zin nas/ gsum pa dam can shwa na bzhi dang / bse'i skyes bu mched bzhi la bskul ba ni/ gzhung las/ dam can shwa na bcu gnyis kyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang drug ste/ dam tshig can gyi stong grogs mdzad pa shwa na bzhi sogs dam can bcu gnyis kyis/ zor chen sogs kyi don gong bzhin/ bse sbyin rdo rje la sogs pa dam can bse yi skyes bu mched bzhi yis/ zor chen sogs kyi don gong bzhin/ de yan gyi dam can shwa na bzhi dang bse'i skyes bu mched bzhi la bskul ba bstan zin nas/ bzhi pa chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la bskul ba ni gzhung las/ chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs rnams kyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan te/

de dag gi don yang / ma mo kun gyi bdag mo dpal ldan dkar mo nyi zla lcam dral la sogs pa/ chos skyong srung ma'i lha tshogs khyad par can khyed rnams kyis/ zor chen sogs kyi don gong bzhin/ de yan gyis chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs la bskul ba bstan zin nas/ lnga pa rig 'dzin mthu rtsal can rnams la bskul ba ni/ gzhung las/ rig 'dzin rtsal chen 'khor bcas kyis/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang gsum gyis bstan te/ de dag gi don yang rig 'dzin mthu che la rtsal drag dang ldan pa 'khor dang bcas pa la sogs pa mdor na skyabs mgon dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ zor rdzas chen po 'di rnams dang / thun rdzas chen po 'di rnams kyi mthu nus dang rno ngar bskyed la/ dgra bgegs rnams kyi srog 'phrog pa dang nus mthu dang gzi brjid dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa rnams skad cig nyid la 'joms pa sogs drag po mngon spyod kyi las la mnga' brnyes pa'i khro bo'i lha tshogs khyed rnams las 'di myur ba nyid du 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod cig de yan gyis rigs 'dzin mthu rtsal can rnams la bskul ba bstan zin nas/ drug pa zor rdzas nus ldan du mngags shing pho nya drag tu bskul ba ni/ gzhung las/ bdag gi gtor zor gnyan po 'di/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu drug gis bstan te de dag gi don yang / rig pa 'dzin pa bdag gis slar zor du 'phangs par byed pa gtor ma gnyan po 'di nyid ni/ rigs 'dzin rig pa'i bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyis ye shes lnga ldan du byin gyis brlab cing / yi dam mkha' 'gro rnams kyis nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa dang ldan par bskyed la/ dam can srung ma rnams kyis mtshon cha dang dug khrag me phung 'bar ba sogs drag po'i rdzas su bsgrub cing / de bas na da lta yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i gtor ma 'di nyid zhi rgyas dbang drag gi las thams cad thogs med du bsgrub pa'i gzhir gyur pa yin pas sdang byed gzugs can gyi dgra la 'phen par byed pa'i zor yang 'di yin la/

gnod byed gzugs med kyi bgegs la 'phen par byed pa'i zor yang 'di/ bsam ngan sbyor rtsub byed pa'i gdug pa can thal ba rdul du rlog par byed pa'i zor yang 'di/ dgra bo'i rigs brgyud bdun brgyud tshun chad gcod par byed pa'i zor yang 'di/ lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas pa'i dmag dpung bskyed de dgra bgegs 'joms par byed pa'i zor yang 'di nyid yin pas rgyu mtshan de dag gi phyir skyabs mgon dam pa khyed rnams kyis zor rdzas chen po 'di dag rnams kyi mthu nus dang rno ngar bskyed la/ dgra bgegs dmigs yul gang yin pa de rnams kyi srog 'phrog pa sogs drag po mngon spyod kyi las la mnga' brnyes pa'i khro tshogs khyed rnams kyis las 'di myur ba nyid du 'grub pa'i stong grogs mdzod cig dam tshig can gyi bka' bstod chos skyong srung ma drag las 'di sgrub pa la mthu ma chung zhig mgyogs byed pho nya las mkhan gyi tshogs rnams drag las 'di bsgrub pa la rtsal ma zhan par/ bh+yoḥbh+yoḥsdang ba'i dgra rnams la bh+yoḥ bh+yoḥbh+yoḥganod pa'i bgegs rnams la bh+yoḥ zhes pa'i don can gyi tshig rnams brjod pas zor gyi las la bskul zhing snyan mnan nas/ gtso bo yab yum sogs lha thams cad 'dus pa'i sngags kī la ya dang / yum chen gyi sngags dang / khro bo bcu/ sgo ma bzhi/ gzhi rnying gcig tu dril ba'i sngags ma rak+mo sogs dang / gur gyi mgon po'i man ngag las 'byung ba'i thun sngags nus mthu can 'di yang bzla bar gsungs te/ sum trig rak+ṣa bh+yoḥzhes pa nas mā ra ya phaṭ zhes pa'i bar rnams gsum gsum la sogs pa ci rigs pa brjod/ de rjes dpal ldan mgon po sogs kyi sgo nas mgon po 'khor bcas la thun gtor rnams phul nas/ ye shes lnga ldan sogs kyis dngos grub bslang ba dang / yi ge brgya pas nongs pa'i tshogs bzod par gsol ba/ rang gi mdun gyi gtor mgron gyi rten sogs la brtan bzhugs bya ba dang /

rtag chad kyi mtha' bsal nas go bgo zhing bsrung ba/ bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis dang bcas pa rnams sgrub thabs nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin nyams su len pa ni nub dang po rnams kyi bya ba'o/ /de dag gis ni dngos gzhi'i cho ga'i sngon du 'gro ba gnas yo byin rlabs sogs bshad pa/ dngos gzhi'i cho ga ting nge 'dzin sgom pa'i tshul bshad pa/ rjes kyi cho ga zor rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa gsum gyi sgo nas nub dang po rnams la bya ba'i cho ga'i don rnams ma lus pa bstan zin to/ /'dir smras pa/ rdo rje slob dpon bstan dang rnal 'byor la/ /pha rol gnod pa mtha' dag gzhom pa'i phyir/ /gzhung bzhin drag po'i yo byad 'du bya ba/ /man ngag 'di yi sbyor ba'i chos su bshad/ /skyabs 'gro tshogs gnyis bsag pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /mtshams bcad bshags pa byin dbab sngon 'gro bas/ /ting 'dzin gsum gyi sgro 'dogs legs bcad nas/ /dkyil 'khor rnam gsum sgom pa bskyed rim lam/ /rang dang bsgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la/ /mchod bstod bzlas brjod zab mos mnyes byed cing / /kun kyang rdzogs rim lta ba mtha' bral gyi/ /ngang nas bgyid pa rim gnyis zung 'jug lam/ /bsrung bzlog gsad pa'i ting 'dzin thabs mkhas kyis/ /nang gi nyon mongs phyi rol dgra 'dre'i gzugs/ /gcad bya gcod byed bral ba'i chos dbyings su/ /sgrol ba'i chos 'di gzhan las ngo mtshar gnas/ /rang nyid cher rlom dregs pa rgyang bsrings te/ /bla ma yi dam bstan srung mchog rnams kyi/ /thugs rje bskul nas zor rdzas byin rlabs pa'i/ /man ngag 'di yang kun dang thun mong min/ /de sogs sa skya'i rje btsun yab chos mchog /lhad med rdo rje phur pa'i lam 'di la/ /blo mig dag pa'i mig gis lta shes na/ /gzhan las khyad par 'phags chos mang zhig mthong / /bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //da ni nub tha ma la bya ba'i cho ga'i rim pa'i don rnams bshad par bya ste/

de yang gzhung las/ nub tha ma zhes pa nas/ bkra shis rnams rgyas par bya'o/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan te de dag gi don yang / nub tha ma la tshogs bar pa bshags pa yan chad gong bzhin byas la/ gsum pa rjes drag po'i las dngos bstan pa la'ang gsum/ sngon 'gro yang 'grel so drug bya ba/ dngos gzhi gdab pa'i las byas nas ling ro 'bul ba/ rjes bzlog pa zor gyi las bstan pa dang gsum/ dang po la gser skyems gtong ba/ phur kha bsgyur ba/ lha srung spyan drangs shing dgug gzhug bya ba/ gsal ba gsum dang gdeng gsum gsal btab ste nga rgyal bskyed pa/ mnyes pa'i dpang gzugs pa/ rdzas smod mo ting nge 'dzin sogs drug bya ba dang drug las/ dang po ni ji ltar bde ba'i sar ras gzhi la mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi bcos pa'i khar 'brub khung nag po gru gsum pa mthar me ris dang bcas pa bris pa'i dbus su liṅga rnams bzhag pa'i lcags snod de nyid bzhag la/ rnal 'byor pa rang gi g.yas phyogs su gu gul yungs kar nag sngo dmar gyi zhags pa/ dug khrag sbyar ba'i thun/ lcags zangs rdo'i phye ma rnams dang / rang gi g.yon du gdab phur rnams dang / ral gri tho ba/ de dag la ngar bskyed pa'i sman phud dang rak+ta cung zad/ rdo rje dril bu rnams bshams/ sgrub pa po rnams he ru ka'i chas su zhugs pas gser skyems gtsang ma khyer nas/ de nyid bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pa gong sgrub thabs kyi skabs su 'byung ba bzhin byas la rgyas bar na 'jam po'i 'khyil 'cham ste dgra bgegs grub kyi sngon 'gro rnga 'cham gyi skabs su phyag bzhes la mdzad pa de nyid dang / dbyangs kyang gu ru'i snyan dbyangs te bla ma rig 'dzin ma'i dbyangs 'di nyid bya ba lag len rgyas pa'i phyogs la de ltar yin kyang / gtor bzlog gi skabs 'dir phyag len bsdus pa dang 'brel ba da lta ji ltar mdzad pa bzhin gyi 'chams tshul cung zad dang bskul tshig dbyangs dang bcas pas mchod pa ste/

de yang 'di skad brjod par bya ste/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa dang / /zhes sogs te 'di la don tshan brgyad de/ rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma dang yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs la 'bul ba/ sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha'i tshogs la 'bul ba/ bye brag rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba/ phur pa'i bka' srung thun mong ma yin pa rnams la 'bul ba/ bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo rnams la 'bul ba/ phyogs skyong gzhi bdag la 'bul ba/ lha klu gnod sbyin sogs la btang pa/ 'khu ldog byed pa'i 'byung po rnams la btang ste bskrad pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gzhung las/ rgyal ba dgongs pa'i zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gcig ste/ de dag gi don ni chos sku kun tu bzang po sogs rgyal ba dgongs pa'i brgyud pa dang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas la sogs pa rigs 'dzin rigs pa'i brgyud pa dang / 'khon ston klu'i dbang po srung ba la sogs pa snyan nas snyan du brgyud pa'i bla ma ste brgyud pa gsum ldan gyi bla ma dam pa rnams mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes shig bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi grangs tsam gyi zhi ba'i lha ste/ de'ang rigs lnga yab yum bcu/ nye ba'i sras brgyad yab yum bcu drug gshin rje gshed/ stobs po che/ rta mgrin/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ste sgo ba bzhi yab yum brgyad/ rigs drug gi thub pa drug rigs thams cad kyi bdag po kun bzang yab yum gnyis rnams so/ /gal te gshin rje gshed sogs bzhi khro bor 'jog pa ma yin nam snyam na/ gdul bya 'dul ba'i phyir du zhi khro sna tshogs su sprul pa'i sku yin pas mtshan khro bo la/ nyams zhi ba'i cha lugs su bzhugs pa'i sku yang srid pas mtha' gcig tu ma nges mod/ gang ltar 'di pa rang gi lugs la zhi ba'i nyams dgu dang ldan pa zhig la zhi ba'i lhar 'jog par bshad de/ zhi ba'i nyams dgu ni/ mnyan lcug 'khril ldem gzhon tshul can/ /gsal 'tsher lhun stug gzi brjid ldan/

/zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de bzhin du lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi grangs can gyi khro bo'i tshogs rnams ni gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa'i khro bo'i skur ston pa ste/ de'ang lnga bcu rtsa brgyad ni phur pa rtsa ba'i lnga bcu rtsa gcig kun bzang rigs lnga/ khrag 'thung he ru ka yab yum gnyis rnams la ngos 'dzin par bshad pa yin la/ de ltar na brgyud pa gsum ldan gyi bla ma'i tshogs rnams dang / dam pa rigs brgya la sogs pa yi dam zhi khro'i tshogs te/ de thams cad ma lus shing lus pa med pa bdud rtsi'i phud kyi mchod pa 'dis mnyes par gyur nas dngos grub stsal du gsol/ de yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams la byis pa'i blo'i spyod yul du mi mngon pa spros pa'i mtha' thams cad dang bral ba'i dbyings kyi ngang las ma g.yos bzhin du tshad med pa'i thugs rje chen pos nye bar dgongs te/ sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang rdzu 'phrul gyi dpung nye bar bskyangs par mdzad nas bstan pa dang sems can la gnod par byed pa'i gdug pa can gyi dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes chos dbyings su bsgral ba'i las byed pa 'di la/ 'gal rkyen phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad gang yang mi 'byung zhing / mthun rkyen mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnam pa gnyis gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ de yan gyis bla ma dang yi dam zhi khro la 'bul ba bstan zin nas/ gnyis pa sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi tshogs la 'bul ba ni/ gzhung las/ 'jam dpal sku yi zhes sogs tshig rkang bco lngas bstan te/ de dag gi don yang / yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams kyi gtso bor gyur pa 'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs rnams dang / pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs/ yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs/ bdud rtsi yon tan lha tshogs/ 'phrin las phur pa'i lha tshogs/ ma mo sbod stong gi lha tshogs/ smod pa drag sngags kyi lha tshogs/

'jig rten mchod bstod kyi lha tshogs/ 'chi med rdo rje tshe yi lha tshogs dang 'dus pa mdo dang sgyu 'phrul gyi lha tshogs rnams kyis kyang gser skyems bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la dngos grub dam pa stsal du gsol/ de yang rnal 'byor pa bdag cag sogs tshig rkang 'og ma rnams kyi 'bru gnyer ba gong gi rig 'gre sbyar te shes par bya ba yin la/ de yan gyis sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi lha tshogs la 'bul ba bstan zin nas/ gsum pa bye brag rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba ni/ gzhung las/ bcom ldan rdo rje gzhon nu zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gcig gis bstan te/ de dag gi don yang 'phrin las phur bu'i lha tshogs kyi bye brag ches mchog tu gyur pa bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu dang / yum chen 'khor lo rgyas 'debs/ 'jigs byed khro bcu yab yum/ de dag las sprul pa'i phra thabs nyi shu/ ye shes kyi rang bzhin sgo skyong ma bzhi/ sras mchog phur bu rigs lnga'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis gser skyems bdud rtsi'i mchod pa 'di bzhes la dngos grub dam pa bstsal du gsol/ de yang sogs tshig 'og ma rnams kyi don gong bzhin/ de yan gyis rdo rje phur pa'i lha tshogs la 'bul ba bstan zin nas/ bzhi pa phur pa'i bka' srung rnams la 'bul ba ni gzhung las dam can bka' srung bcu gnyis zhes sogs tshig rkang bcu gsum gyis bstan te/ de dag gi don yang dam tshig can gyi bka'i bya ra ba srung ma dam can bcu gnyis dang / ging chen bco brgyad sogs dge bsnyen chen po'i tshul du ston pa 'khor bcas rnams dang / dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i 'khor tshogs za byed dbang mo'i phyi nang mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug gi phyogs bzhi'i dbang phyug ma bdun bdun te bdun bzhi nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang / lhag ma za ba'i mkha' 'gro'i bye brag pho nya mo stobs ldan sum cu rtsa gnyis/

phra men ma bco brgyad/ 'bar ma brgyad/ ma bdun sring bzhi la sogs pa rnams dang / bdud 'dul nag mo mched bzhi dang / mgyogs pa'i las byed pho nya gsum brgya drug cu/ khyad par dpal ldan re ma ti la sogs pa/ mdor na dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i yang bran 'khor tshogs rnams/ gser skyems gtsang zhing gtsang ma yid du 'ong ba 'di bzhes la/ bstan dgra gdug pa can dgra bgegs kyi rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su bsgral ba'i las byed pa 'di la/ 'gal rkyen phyi nang gsang gsum gyi bar chad gang yang mi 'byung zhing / mthun rkyen mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub rnam pa gnyis gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ 'di yan gyis phur pa'i bka' srung thun mong ma yin pa rnams la 'bul ba bstan zin nas/ lnga pa bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo rnams la 'bul ba ni/ gzhung las/ bstan pa bsrung mdzad kun gyi gtso zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan te de dag gi don yang / sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad pa'i bstan srung kun gyi gtso bor gyur pa dpal ldan rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po lcam dral/ 'phrin las rab tu myur ba'i las mkhan chen po pu tra sogs bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / zhing skyong dregs byed kun gyi dbang phyug dpal mgon gdong bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi la sogs pa/ dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa kun kyang gser skyems gtsang zhing sogs tshig 'og ma rnams kyi 'bru gnyer gong bzhin shes par bya la/ de yan gyis bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo rnams la 'bul ba bstan zin nas/ drug pa phyogs skyong gzhi bdag la 'bul ba ni/ gzhung las/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong rnams dang / zhes sogs tshigs rkang drug gis bstan te/ de dag gi don yang shar la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa rnams dang /

sgrub pa po gang du gnas pa'i gnas bdag la sogs pa kun dang / yul bdag kun kyang gser skyems gtsang ma yid du 'ong ba 'dis tshim par byas nas/ 'khon 'dzin drag pos bstan pa dang sems can la gnod par byed pa'i gdug pa can gyi dgra bgegs 'di bsgral ba la 'gal rkyen byed dang 'khu ldog la sogs pa ma mdzad par/ mthun rkyen stong grogs gnyan po ci dang ci nus pa mdzod/ de yan gyis phyogs skyong dang gzhi bdag la 'bul ba bstan zin nas/ bdun pa lha klu gnod sbyin sogs la btang ba ni/ gzhung las/ sa yi phyogs ni 'di nyid na/ /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gnyis kyis bstan te/ de dag gi don yang / gzhan yang drag po'i las bya ba'i sa yi phyogs ga la ba 'di nyid na/ sa'i cha'am nam mkha'i cha la 'khod pa yi lha dang klu dang gnod sbyin dang / dri za la sogs pa dang gzhan yang 'byung po'i rigs mang po gang dang gang 'khod pa thams cad kyang bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pa 'dis tshim par gyur nas gnod byed gdug pa'i dgra bgegs 'di bsgral bar byed pa la khyed rnams ru nga ba dang phrag dog pa ma mdzad par/ mthun rkyen myur du sgrol ba'i stong grogs gnyan po ci nus pa mdzod cig de yan gyis lha klu gnod sbyin sogs la btang ba bstan zin nas/ brgyad pa 'khu ldog byed pa'i 'byung po rnams la btang ste bskrad pa ni/ gzhung las/ lha yi phyag rgya mi bzod cing / /zhes sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bstan te/ de dag gi don yang gzhan yang bskyed rim brtan po'i lha yi phyag rgya'i gzi brjid mi bzod cing de nyid la byer dang 'khu ldog byed pa'i rigs rnams kyang byer dang 'khu ldog ma byed par gser skyems gtsang ma bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin 'dis tshim par byas nas/ lus sems ci bde bar ni gnas gzhan du dengs shig gam song zhig ces pa 'di dag gis ni gser skyems rgyas par 'bul ba'i tshig gi ni 'bru don rnams bshad zin pa yin la/

gser skyems bsdus pa 'bul tshul ni/ bla ma rigs 'dzin tshogs bcas mchod/ /zhes sogs te/ 'di la don tshan drug ste/ bla ma yi dam spyi dang bye brag la 'bul ba/ phur pa'i bka' srung rnams la 'bul ba/ bstan srung gtso bo la 'bul ba/ phyogs skyong gzhi bdag la 'bul ba/ lha klu sogs la btang ba/ 'byung po la btang ste bskrad pa'o/ /dang po ni gzhung las/ bla ma rigs 'dzin zhes sogs tshig rkang dgus bstan te de dag gi don yang / brgyud pa gsum ldan gyi bla ma rig pa 'dzin pa'i tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / spyir thabs shes dbyer med kyi yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams/ khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs khyed rnams bdud rtsi phud kyi mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la/ byis pa'i blo'i spyod yul du mi mngon pa'i zhes sogs tshig rkang 'og ma rnams kyi 'bru gnyer gong gi de bzhin rigs 'gre bar bya ba yin la/ gnyis pa phur srung la 'bul ba ni gzhung las/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi/ /zhes sogs tshig rkang bdun gyis bstan te/ de dag gi don yang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi spyan sngar srog snying phul nas spyir bstan pa skyong bar khas blangs shing dam bcas/ khyad par rdo rje phur pa'i srung mar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dam can bdag nyid ma bzhi sogs bka' srung rgya mtsho'i tshogs khyed rnams bdud rtsi phud kyis mchod pa dam pa 'di bzhes la bstan dgra gdug pa can gyi dgra bgegs sogs tshig 'og ma rnams kyi don rnams gong rgyas pa'i skabs bzhin sbyar ro/ /de nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsrung bar mdzad pa'i bstan srung kun gyi gtso bo zhes sogs kyis gsum pa bstan srung gtso bo la 'bul ba dang / de bzhin du bzhi pa phyogs skyong gzhi bdag la 'bul ba/ lnga pa lha klu sogs la btang ba/ drug pa 'byung po la btang ste bskrad pa rnams kyi don tshan gsum pa man chad kyi gzhung dang gzhung don du bcas pa rnams kyang gong rgyas pa'i skabs su bshad pa bzhin 'dir yang shes par bya'o/

/de nas skabs 'dir rigs 'dzin bskul ba phyag len la mdzad pas/ de yang grub pa'i mtshan ma brnyes pa'i rigs 'dzin mthu rtsal can rnams drag po'i las la bskul ba 'di la don gsum du gnas pa yin te/ spyir bskul ba dang / so sor bskul ba dang / don bsdu ba'i tshul gyis bskul ba'o/ /dang po ni byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed cing zhes sogs te/ de yang bla na med pa yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi mchog tu sems gnyis bskyed cing / dus gsum gyi rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i gdung 'tshob par mdzad pa'i rig 'dzin chen po rnams zhes bos nas/ rig 'dzin khyed rnams kyis sngar sems can gyi don mdzad par zhal gyis bzhes pa de da dus la bab pa bdag rnal 'byor pa sems can thams cad kyi don du rdo rje phur bu sgrub pa'i stong grogs dang mgon skyabs mdzod cig ces pa'i don yin la/ gnyis pa so sor bskul ba ni/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /zhes sogs te de yang slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis a su ra'i brag phug dang 'dab nye ba'i rgya gar gyi yul phyogs su tsan+dan gyi nags tshal la/ nags gseb na mu stegs kyi grong khyer yod pa de bcom pa'i phyir phur bu btab pas nags tshal thams cad nag thul gyis tshig de ma khad la ting nge 'dzin cho 'phrul gyi sgo nas lo 'dab me tog rnams rgyas par mdzad pa la sogs pa ji ltar grub pa'i rtags bstan pa de mnyel lam ci ste ma mnyel bar mdzod la rnal 'byor pa bdag cag rdo rje phur bu'i dngos grub sgrub pa'i stong grogs dang 'phrin las mdzod cig ces pa ste tshig rkang rjes ma gnyis kyi don 'og ma kun la 'gre ba yin zhing / de bzhin du slob dpon chen po bi ma la mi tra ste dri med bshes gnyen gyis gaṅga la ste nam mkha' nas babs pa'i chu bo chen po la klu nor rgyas bya ba mu stegs la 'tsho ba ster ba zhig yod par bcom pa'i phyir phur pa btab pas gram par skya hrog gis song zhing /

slar chu bo sngar bas kyang cher song ba la sogs pa grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / bal po'i slob dpon chen po shi la mañdzu ste 'jam dpal tshul khrims de yis maṇ+ḍa la te dkyil 'khor 'du ba'i mkhar gong gi brag la mu stegs la mngon shes ston pa'i the'u rang gi pho brang yod pa de bcom pa'i phyir du phur bu btab pas brag grul gyis zhig 'phral slar brag ri ngo mtshar ba byung ba'i grub rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / gzhan yang mchims ston shākya pra bha wa zhes bya bas yar lung bgegs kyi phug chung ste gang pa phug tu dam sri spun bdun dngos su brtul ba dang / gzhan yang phug pa de nyid du rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ yar lung gi chu bo de la klu bdud gdug pa can gnas pa de nyid 'dul ba'i ched du bsnyen phur chu bo de la btab pas chu bo de nyid gyen la log te klu bdud gdug pa can btul ba la sogs pa grub pa bsnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / yang shud bu dpal gyi seṅges 'on shang gi mdo'i brag ri dmar po la klu bdud gdug pa can gnas pa phur bus bsgral ba la sogs pa grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / sna rnam rdo rje bdud 'joms kyis hal po ri yi yang gong du brag la phur pa btab pa'i rjes da lta'i bar du yod pa sogs grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / mkhar chen bza'i ste ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis ching bu'i nags la me shor ba la phur bu btab pas me shi nas slar nags tshal skyes pa dang / dgung mkhar te sgrub khang gi steng du dbu skra bsil ba'i tshe phyag phreng na bza'i steng du bzhag pa bdud kyi sprul pa bya rog ma rung pa zhig gis phreng ba khyer song ba la brtag gzhib dpyad pas rdo rje gzhon nu bsgrub pa la bdud nag po skrag med kyis bar chad rtsom par dgongs te/ pho rog nag po'i grib ma sa la yod pa la phur pa btab pas pho rog gam bya rog skad cig de nyid la tshar bcad pa lta bu grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang /

yang mkha' 'gro ma ye shes mtsho rgyal gyi ming po mkhar chen dpal gyi dbang phyug gis 'u yug mkhar ba sna zhes bya bar phur bu bsgrubs pas/ de'i byang phyogs na bye ma'i rtsibs spyang ki 'dra ba zhig yod la/ de'i skabs yar ldong gi tshong pa mang po yong ba'i tshong lha rgyal po shel ging gis byed pa las/ rgyal po de khros nas spyang ki bcu bzhir sprul nas thog mar rta bong rnams bsad rjes tha mar mi rnams kyang za ba la byung bas/ tshong pa rnams kyis lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul yin par shes te/ yul 'dir sngags 'chang grub rtags 'thon pa su yod ces yul mi kun la dris pas/ mkhar sna la dpal gyi dbang phyug bzhugs zhes gleng gin 'dug pa ltar mkhar snar phyin te zhus pas/ de rnams bstan pa la zhabs tog byed nges pa'i sbyin bdag yin par mkhyen nas/ rtsibs kyi bye ma pha gi la spyang ki'i sder rjes yod pas de'i bye ma long zhig ngas thabs bya'o gsungs/ sder rjes kyi bye ma phul bas/ bye ma dang bag phye bsres nas spyang ki'i gzugs bcu bzhi bzos pa la dgug gzhug mdzad nas/ bzlas yungs kyis brab cing phur bu btab pas spyang ki sngon po rnams kyi snying shubs nas rgyang gis 'thon te/ spyang ki bcu bzhi po thams cad sgrub khang gi thog na mar ri nyil ba ltar byung ste/ rgyal po shel ging skad cig de nyid la tshar bcad pa lta bu grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / gzhan yang 'khon ston chen po klu'i dbang po srung bas lha sa yer pa'i brag phug tu rdo rje dril bu bar snang la bzhag pa la sogs pa'i grub rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / gcung ston rdo rje rin chen zhes bya bas smad las drag po sgrol ba'i dbang bskur mdzad pa'i dus de'i tshe liṅga la 'phar g.yo sgra 'ong la sogs pa ngo mtshar ba'i ltas du ma bstan pa dang / 'khon ston bal po zhes bya bas tsha mo rong glang gi brag phug tu rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub pa mdzad pas zhal mngon sum du gzigs shing sgrub chu ston pa la sogs grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang /

sngags 'chang rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos khams kyi grum pa zhes bya ba'i yul mthon po zhig tu sems can thams cad chu med pas sdug bsngal bar gyur pa la/ brag la phur ba btab pas sgrub chu dngos su ston te sems can rnams la phan pa rgya chen po mdzad pa la sogs pa grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / sa lo tsā ba 'jam pa'i dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams kyis grub thob 'bam rom pa chen po'i sgrub gnas 'bam rom brag ces bya ba'i gnas mchog khyad par can du rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgrub pa mdzad pas dgun gyi dus su'ang 'jam dbyangs me tog shin tu mang bar skyes shing / brag de nyid la phyag zhabs kyi rjes kun gyis mthong bar bstan pa sogs grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags ji ltar bstan pa dang / snyigs dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang ngag gi dbang po kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos sngon gyi gnas rjes su dgongs pa dang / bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha'i zhal mngon sum du gyur te gdams pa dang rjes su gdams pa nod ba'i dus la bab par dgongs nas lho rong gi sa'i cha spa gro stag tshang seṅge bsam grub kyi gnas mchog tu phyag phebs par brtsams te lho rong phyogs su chibs kha bsgyur ba'i tshe/ spa gro'i gzhi bdag lha chen brag bskyed dang / has kyi khyung 'dus sogs lho kha bzhi'i gzhi bdag rnams sngags 'chang nyid kyi zhabs drung du byung nas/ lho rong gi sa yul thams cad zhabs kyi 'chag dgos shing / la chu 'phrang sogs kyi 'phrin las thams cad nged gzhi bdag rnams kyis sgrub pa yin no zhes khas blangs song bas/ sngags 'chang nyid kyis kyang dus der gtor ma rgya chen po gnang zhing / lhag par bsang dpe chen mor/ spa gro'i lha chen brag bskyed dang / /has kyi khyung 'dus la sogs pa'i/ /lho rong lung pa'i gzhi bdag bsang /

/zhes pa 'di yang de'i dus su 'jug par mdzad pa yin zhes thos la/ de nas bdag nyid chen pos spa gro'i sgrub gnas dam par phebs par dgongs nas nags kyi 'phrang dog par brten chibs pas bgrod ma bde ba la dgongs ste/ long ra dbon po sogs lho pa gzhon pa mang pos rgyab tu sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku gdan drangs te stag tshang gi 'phrang zin par phebs pa'i tshe de'i lam bar zhig tu skye mthing shwa na ma sogs gzhi bdag 'ga' zhig gi cho 'phrul gyis sems can ma rung pa zhig gis lam bgags byung ba la/ sngags 'chang nyid kyis nged rang gi rang gnas su 'gro ba la khyad ci yod/ phar song gsungs pa la sogs kyi bka' bsgo mdzad pas sems can gyi gzugs de dngos med du yal song ba der yod kun gyis mthong zhing / de nas spa gro'i lam 'phrang la phebs pas gnas de na brag ri ngams che ba/ ri gzhan las thog so dgu tsam gyis mtho ba zhig yod pa de'i mgor sngon mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal gyis shel phreng brgya rtsa gtor ba'i chu mig brgya rtsa yod pa'i chu de thams cad brag chen po de'i mdun ngos la dar dkar gyi yol ba bkram pa ltar ngo mtshar che bar 'bab pa zhig yod pa'i brag la chu 'thab de'i dkyil du glo bur nyid du 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i 'od sgor gsum bsgrigs shig byung nas/ de'i dbus nas 'ja' kha dog sngon po zhig rgyang gis byung ba sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku la zug cing / zhabs drung na gnas pa'i sku 'khor kun la yang 'ja' de'i 'od kyis khyab pa la brten nas mi'i mdog dang gos gzan sogs thams cad sngon po 'ba' zhig gyur ba der yod kyi skye bo kun gyis mthong ba byung zhing / de'i tshe 'phrang de'i g.yas g.yon gyi ljon shing gi tshogs la brten pa'i spra dang spre'u lag na shing gi yal ga thogs pa mang pos mi la mi 'dzem par gral bsgrigs te langs nas sngags 'chang nyid la bsu ba'i tshul du 'dug pa ni de dus zhabs drung du 'dug pa kun gyis mthong bar grags la/

de'i tshe sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal pos sngar gyi brag la chu 'thab nas byung pa'i 'ja' 'od rnams je gsal je gsal du song byung ba la gzigs pas/ de'i dbus 'od dkar po zhig gi khrod na bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu'i dkyil 'khor la bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bskor ba dang / de'i steng phyogs na slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas gtso 'khor gsum dang / grub thob rig 'dzin mang po khrom tshogs su bzhugs pa'i mtha' skor du dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor ba dang / mkha' 'gro sde lnga gar stabs shig shig 'dug pa ni shin tu gsal bar gzigs nas/ de'i tshe sngags 'chang nyid kyis stag tshang gi phug pa'i g.yas 'khris na ne'u gsing mthil pa zhig yod pa der bzhugs nas/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor thugs nyams su bzhes pas/ sngar gyi gzigs snang la shar ba'i bla ma yi dam rnams kyi sku las 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan nyi ma bye ba'i gzi 'od tsam dang / bla ma yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rdul 'khrigs pa ltar byung nas sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku la thim par gyur te/ skad cig de nyid la thugs la tha mal gyi rnam rtog gi cha shas cung zad yod pa thams cad khrig 'gags nas/ snang srid thams cad lhag pa'i lha'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lor khra lam gyi shar nas de la thugs zin te bde chen lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes kyi ngang du lhan gyis gnas byung bas/ de ma thag dpa'o mkha' 'gro rigs 'dzin grub thob kyi lha tshogs thams cad 'od sngon po zhig tu gyur nas slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la thim zhing / slob dpon yang 'od du zhu la khad 'dug pa gzigs pas/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po nyid kyi thugs dgongs la da tshe tshad kyang nye bar rdzogs 'gro ba 'dug pas 'ja' 'od de'i steng na phar phyin te slob dpon gyi phyi la 'brangs na dga' ba 'dug snyam thugs la shar ba'i tshe/

yang de ma thag dpal ldan sa skya'i sde chen po gtsug lag khang dang bcas pa thugs yul du khra lam ste shar zhing / gdung brgyud 'jam pa'i dbyangs sku mched kyang sku na gzhon par dgongs nas/ sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis brlab pa'i dgongs pa gtad de/ de 'phral gu ru drag po'i nyams bzhes shar ma zhig gnang bas/ slob dpon chen po'i sku de sngar las gsal bar gyur pa'i mod la gdams pa zab mo dang / lung bstan rab tu mang po gnang zhing / lhag par da dung lo du ma'i bar du bstan 'gro'i don dpag tu med pa 'grub par 'dug cing / de nas dag pa'i zhing bde ba can zang mdog dpal gyi rir pad+ma nga'i drung du byon gsungs pa snyam byed pa'i tshe/ slob dpon nyid kyang 'od sngon po zhig tu zhu nas sngags 'chang nyid kyi sku la thim pa'i thugs nyams shin tu gsal bar byung pa'i mod la/ rtog pa dang mi rtog pa thams cad las 'das te bde gsal mi rtog pa'i ye shes rgyal ba rnams kyi rgyud la ji ltar mnga' ba bzhin sngags 'chang nyid kyi thugs la 'khrungs par gyur nas/ re zhig de'i ngang la 'byams te/ de las sad pa na nyi ma yang phyi mor song 'dug pas myur du bzhengs nas/ de'i nye 'khor na 'bab chu zhig yod par phebs te dpon slob thams cad kyis sku khrus mdzad pas de'i brag zhig la sngags 'chang nyid kyi phyag zhabs kyi rjes byung ba da lta yang dad pa can rnams kyi bsod nams kyi zhing du bzhugs pa kun la grags pa sogs mdor na yul dus gnas skabs kun tu grub pa'i rtags mtshan bsam gyis mi khyab pa ston par mdzad pa'i sngags 'chang bstan pa'i gsal byed chen po 'di nyid kyi ngo mtshar ba'i mdzad pa'i tshul rnams zhib tu rtogs par 'dod na kho bos byas pa'i rnam thar ngo mtshar rgya mtsho las rtogs par bya zhing / 'dir bkod pa'i spa gro'i stag tshang seṅge bsam grub tu grub pa brnyes pa'i rtags mtshan bstan pa'i tshul 'di rnams ni/
